required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Cover Component
required_documents.details: Standard institutional cover component for multi-project Center application on ASSIST or Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract (Overall and per Core/Project)
required_documents.details: Summary of the Superfund Research Program Center theme, core aims, and interdisciplinary scope (max 30 lines each).

required_documents.name: Project Narrative (Overall Public Health Relevance)
required_documents.details: Two or three sentences on how hazardous waste research reduces toxic environmental exposures and protects public health.

required_documents.name: Overall Center Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing Center Integration, Center Theme, Synergy between Biomedical and Non-Biomedical Projects, and Environmental Relevance.

required_documents.name: Administrative Core Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing leadership, governance, scientific coordination, and fiscal management of the Center.

required_documents.name: Translational Research and Engagement Core (TREC)
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing how research findings will be translated to communities, regulators (EPA, state agencies), and stakeholders.

required_documents.name: Research Projects Strategy (Min 3, Max 4 Projects)
required_documents.details: Each individual research project requires a 12-page Research Strategy. Must include at least 2 biomedical and 1 non-biomedical (engineering/environmental science) project.

required_documents.name: Data Management and Analysis Core (DMAC)
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing data stewardship, FAIR principles, bioinformatics support, and data sharing infrastructure.

required_documents.name: Community Engagement Core (CEC)
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages detailing bidirectional engagement with affected communities near hazardous waste and Superfund sites.

required_documents.name: Senior/Key Person Profiles and Biosketches
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for Center Director, Core Leaders, Project Leaders, and Key Personnel (max 5 pages each).
required_documents.source: RFA-ES-27-004-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: Detailed Line-Item Budgets (per Component)
required_documents.details: Itemized R&R Budget forms for Overall Center and each separate Core and Research Project. Direct costs capped at $1.75M annually.

required_documents.name: Letters of Support from EPA, State Regulators, and Community Partners
required_documents.details: Letters confirming scientific collaboration with federal/state environmental regulators (e.g. EPA Region 4, NC DEQ) and community groups.
required_documents.source: RFA-ES-27-004-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Letters of Support

required_documents.name: SAM.gov and eRA Commons Registrations
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with UEI and eRA Commons affiliations for all Center leaders.

deadlines.when: September 25, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Public and private institutions of higher education only. In North Carolina, universities with top-tier environmental health and environmental sciences programs (such as UNC Chapel Hill, Duke University, and NC State University) are eligible.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

review_criteria.criterion: Individual Research Projects (Significance, Investigators, Innovation, Approach, Environment)

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Must contain a minimum of 3 and maximum of 4 research projects, with both biomedical and non-biomedical (engineering/environmental) disciplines represented.
Direct costs are strictly capped at $1,750,000 per year; applications requesting more will be returned without review.
Mandatory cores: Administrative Core, TREC Core, DMAC Core, and Community Engagement Core.
Foreign organizations and foreign subcomponents are not allowed.
